description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/varcoeff_laplacian_dirichlet_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (N bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST for the model: the compound D( k * D(u,x), x ) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior conservative flux-difference stencil aggregate over [2,7]; mirror-ghost fixed-value faces at i=1 and i=8 carrying the free names gL, gR, the wall conductivities k[1], k[8], and dx), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
